_howto: Drives the Search menu and its pages. Lifestyle pages list every club (clubs.json) and community without a club (communities.json) whose "tags" include the page's tag, with an All / With a club / Without a club toggle. Membership pages list clubs only. Paste an IDX Broker embed into "idx" to show live listings on a page. Add, remove or reorder entries here and the menu updates.
